newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGRI-LA TO BUY SLIM INTERNATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: SHANGRI-LA TO BUY SLIM INTERNATIONAL.

text.p: Shangri-La Asia Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to buy 100 percent of the shares in hotel management company SLIM International Ltd.
The company did not disclose financial details, and officials were not immediately available to comment.

SLIM International and its subsidiaries, known as Shangri-La Hotels and Resorts, manage hotels and resorts principally owned by Shangri-La Asia and other members of the Kuok Group as well as third party owners.
The Kuok group held about 58 percent of Shangri-La Asia in early June.
Trading in Shangri-La Asia shares was suspended on Wednesday at the request of the company pending an announcement.
The company reported a 6.3 percent decline in interim net profit to HK$470.95 million.
